name: SourceCoop
author: red_thirten@yahoo.com
description: SourceCoop 是一个面向多人 Source 引擎游戏（如《黑山》）的协作型纯服务端模组，能让玩家在单人战役或地图中共同游玩。此 Egg 目前仅支持《黑山》官方地图，但可轻松修改以支持更多地图（详情请参阅 Egg 的 README 文件）。

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

## File: Pterodactyl SourceCoop Egg - egg-pterodactyl-source-coop.json
## Authors: David Wolfe (Red-Thirten)
## Date: 2025/06/17
## License: MIT License
## Image to install with is 'registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/pterodactyl-images/installers:debian'

# Download and install SteamCMD
export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /tmp
mkdir -p $HOME/steamcmd $HOME/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C $HOME/steamcmd
cd $HOME/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt

## Install/Verify game server using SteamCMD
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "[SteamCMD] Steam user is not set. Using anonymous user."
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
fi
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir $HOME +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit

# Set up 32 and 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p $HOME/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so $HOME/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so $HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# Delete unused texture files, if enabled
if [[ "${DELETE_UNUSED_TEXTURES}" == "1" ]]; then
    echo -e "Deleting unused texture files..."
    rm $HOME/bms/bms_textures*
    rm $HOME/hl2/hl2_textures*
fi

## Install Metamod:Source
echo -e "Installing Metamod:Source (1.12.0-git${MMS_BUILD})..."
cd /tmp
curl -L https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/1.12/mmsource-1.12.0-git${MMS_BUILD}-linux.tar.gz -o mmsource-1.12.0-git${MMS_BUILD}-linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf mmsource-1.12.0-git${MMS_BUILD}-linux.tar.gz -C $HOME/bms

## Install SourceMod
echo -e "Installing SourceMod (1.12.0-git${SM_BUILD})..."
cd /tmp
curl -L https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/1.12/sourcemod-1.12.0-git${SM_BUILD}-linux.tar.gz -o sourcemod-1.12.0-git${SM_BUILD}-linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf sourcemod-1.12.0-git${SM_BUILD}-linux.tar.gz -C $HOME/bms

## Install SourceCoop
echo -e "Installing SourceCoop (${VERSION}-${MATCH})..."
cd /tmp
# this is a simple script to use the github API for release versions.
# this requires the egg has a variable for GITHUB_PACKAGE, VERSION and MATCH (match is to match the filename in some way)
# this supports using oauth/personal access tokens via GITHUB_USER and GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN (both are required.)
# if you are getting hit with GitHub API limit issues then you need to have the user and token set.
GITHUB_PACKAGE="ampreeT/SourceCoop"

if [ -z "${GITHUB_USER}" ] && [ -z "${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN}" ] ; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    echo -e "user and oauth token set"
    alias curl='curl -u ${GITHUB_USER}:${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN} '
fi

# get release info and download links
LATEST_JSON=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases/latest")
RELEASES=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases")

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq .assets | jq -r .[].browser_download_url | grep -i ${MATCH})
else
    VERSION_CHECK=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .tag_name')
    if [ "${VERSION}" == "${VERSION_CHECK}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .assets[].browser_download_url' | grep -i ${MATCH})
    else
        echo -e "defaulting to latest release"
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq .assets | jq -r .[].browser_download_url)
    fi
fi
curl -L ${DOWNLOAD_URL} -o sourcecoop.zip
unzip -o sourcecoop.zip -d $HOME/bms

## Create/Adjust CFG files
cd $HOME/bms/cfg

# Create custom `server.cfg` with ideal default settings
echo -e 'Creating custom "server.cfg" configuration file...'
rm -f server.cfg
cat > server.cfg << EOF
// Black Mesa server.cfg file
hostname "Black Mesa: Coop"
sv_password ""

// provides lag-free noblock, shows teammates as friendly
// and puts an arrow above their head (srccoop handles team switching)
mp_teamplay 1

// set 1 if you hate your friends
mp_friendlyfire 0

// prevents the match from ending when a player has a high enough score
mp_fraglimit 0

// setting 1 disables sprinting
sv_always_run 0

// disables map timelimit
mp_timelimit 0

// If uncommented and nonzero, server will cycle to the next map if it has been empty on the current map for this set number of seconds.
// It is generally recommended to keep this commented, because issues may arise if the server cycles past the last map in the campaign.
//mp_mapcycle_empty_timeout_seconds 3600

// Uncomment to loop back to the first map after finishing a campaign
// Leave commented to use nextmap (mapcycle) instead
sourcecoop_homemap "bm_c0a0a"

// Enables pre-caching of map data (eg. models, etc.)
// Disabling this may resolve crashing/hanging on certain maps (namely bm_c4a4a), but may cause performance issues on other maps.
mod_forcetouchdata 1

rcon_password "" // disable rcon
sv_tags "custom, coop, sourcecoop"
sv_cheats 0
sv_alltalk 1
EOF

# Empty the default `autoexec.cfg` as it does nothing for the server
> "autoexec.cfg"

# Create an empty `userconfig.cfg` to suppress console warnings
> "userconfig.cfg"

## Check for successful installation.
cd $HOME/bms/addons
if [ -d "metamod" ] && [ -d "sourcemod" ] && [ -f "sourcemod/plugins/srccoop.smx" ]; then
    echo -e "\nSourceCoop Dedicated Server successfully installed!\n"
else
    echo -e "\n\n[Error] One or more SourceCoop dependancies failed to install!"
    echo -e "\tTry checking your [Advanced] startup settings and/or reinstalling the server again.\n"
    exit 1
fi

variables.name: 服务器名称
variables.description: 服务器列表中显示的服务器名称。

variables.name: 最大玩家数
variables.description: 你的游戏服务器允许的最大玩家数量。

variables.name: 服务器密码
variables.description: 加入服务器需要密码。留空则无需密码。

variables.name: 起始地图
variables.description: 服务器启动时加载的地图名称。关于黑山基地地图名称的指南，请使用以下链接：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1920599249

variables.name: [高级] 启用 `mod_forcetouchdata`
variables.description: 启用地图数据预缓存（例如模型等）。禁用此选项可能解决某些地图（如 `bm_c4a4a` - Nihilanth）上的崩溃/卡死问题，但可能导致其他地图出现性能问题。

variables.name: [高级] Source Engine 专用服务器应用 ID
variables.description: 用于安装和更新的 Steam 应用 ID。通常无需更改。（黑山基地专用服务器 = 346680 | 半条命2：死亡竞赛专用服务器 = 232370）

variables.name: [高级] 更新黑山基地专用服务器
variables.description: 启动时检查黑山基地专用服务器更新，并在必要时进行更新。此功能默认关闭，因为黑山基地服务器的更新通常也需要同步更新SourceCoop（这需要重新安装服务器）。SourceCoop的更新可能还需要更新Metamod和SourceMod（详见相关设置）。注意：已更新的客户端可能无法加入未更新的服务器。（1 启用 | 0 禁用）

variables.name: [高级] SourceCoop 发布版本标签
variables.description: 在安装/重新安装期间，从 https://github.com/ampreeT/SourceCoop/releases 下载哪个 SourceCoop 版本（基于标签）。注意：如果使用 `latest`，请确保已指定推荐的 Metamod 和 SourceMod 构建版本（有关更多详细信息，请参阅这些设置）。

variables.name: [高级] SourceCoop 发布构建标签
variables.description: 在安装/重新安装期间，从 https://github.com/ampreeT/SourceCoop/releases 下载哪个 SourceCoop 构建版本（基于发布资源中的关键词）。注意：虽然某些 SourceCoop 版本支持 `hl2mp`（半条命2：死亡竞赛），但目前仅官方支持 `bms`（黑山）。

variables.name: [高级] Metamod:Source 构建
variables.description: 安装/重新安装期间下载哪个 Metamod:Source 1.12 构建版本号。如果 SourceCoop 更新可能需要更改，但其他情况下很少需要更改。请参考以下链接获取最新推荐构建版本：https://github.com/ampreeT/SourceCoop?tab=readme-ov-file#-manual-installation

variables.name: [高级] SourceMod 构建
variables.description: 安装/重新安装期间要下载的 SourceMod 1.12 构建版本号。如果 SourceCoop 更新可能需要更改，但通常很少需要更改。请参考以下链接获取最新推荐的构建版本：https://github.com/ampreeT/SourceCoop?tab=readme-ov-file#-manual-installation

variables.name: [主机] 删除未使用的纹理文件
variables.description: 在服务器上，需要的是材质文件而非纹理文件。若启用此设置，未使用的纹理文件将在被SteamCMD下载后删除，以节省约9GB磁盘空间。注意：若启用了"[高级] 更新黑山基地专用服务器"，这些文件可能会被SteamCMD重新下载。（1 启用 | 0 禁用）
